name: GLM-OCR
license_interpretation: Both networks are under permissive licences that allow commercial and closed-source use. The GLM-OCR recognizer is MIT, as declared by its model card (upstream ships no license file or copyright line); keep the license notice with copies. The PP-DocLayoutV3 layout detector is Apache-2.0 (Copyright PaddlePaddle Authors): keep the license text and notices, and it grants a patent license. Both networks run through the Apache-2.0 Hugging Face Transformers classes; LibreYOLO ports only the document-parsing pipeline (layout post-processing, region crops, result formatting) from the GLM-OCR SDK at commit 0288f96bb9e78cb439883eaa725eeae90bd177c5, which is Apache-2.0 (libreyolo/models/glmocr/NOTICE), and the rest of the adapter is MIT. The weights are an unmodified, ungated mirror at LibreYOLO/LibreGLMOCR0.9b of zai-org/GLM-OCR (revision 2e85a62840ccac27daa451df36c736c4636b8628) with PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (revision e4f489dc536556fc1be02b973ba06756e0d4a2ac) under layout/, shipping LICENSE and NOTICE.
